340  * Function:	H5G__dense_insert
 341  *
 342  * Purpose:	Insert a link into the  dense link storage structures for a group
 343  *
 344  * Return:	Non-negative on success/Negative on failure
 345  *
 346  * Programmer:	Quincey Koziol
 347  *		Sep 11 2006
 348  *
 349  *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 350  */
 351 herr_t
 352 H5G__dense_insert(H5F_t *f, const H5O_linfo_t *linfo, const H5O_link_t *lnk)
 353 {
 354     H5G_bt2_ud_ins_t udata;                       /* User data for v2 B-tree insertion */
 355     H5HF_t          *fheap      = NULL;           /* Fractal heap handle */
 356     H5B2_t          *bt2_name   = NULL;           /* v2 B-tree handle for name index */
 357     H5B2_t          *bt2_corder = NULL;           /* v2 B-tree handle for creation order index */
 358     size_t           link_size;                   /* Size of serialized link in the heap */
 359     H5WB_t          *wb = NULL;                   /* Wrapped buffer for link data */
 360     uint8_t          link_buf[H5G_LINK_BUF_SIZE]; /* Buffer for serializing link */
 361     void            *link_ptr  = NULL;            /* Pointer to serialized link */
 362     herr_t           ret_value = SUCCEED;         /* Return value */
 363 
 364     FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE
 365 
 366     /*
 367      * Check arguments.
 368      */
 369     HDassert(f);
 370     HDassert(linfo);
 371     HDassert(lnk);
 372 
 373     /* Find out the size of buffer needed for serialized link */
 374     if ((link_size = H5O_msg_raw_size(f, H5O_LINK_ID, FALSE, lnk)) == 0)
 375         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTGETSIZE, FAIL, "can't get link size")
 376 
 377     /* Wrap the local buffer for serialized link */
 378     if (NULL == (wb = H5WB_wrap(link_buf, sizeof(link_buf))))
 379         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTINIT, FAIL, "can't wrap buffer")
 380 
 381     /* Get a pointer to a buffer that's large enough for link */
 382     if (NULL == (link_ptr = H5WB_actual(wb, link_size)))
 383         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_NOSPACE, FAIL, "can't get actual buffer")
 384 
 385     /* Create serialized form of link */
 386     if (H5O_msg_encode(f, H5O_LINK_ID, FALSE, (unsigned char *)link_ptr, lnk) < 0)
 387         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTENCODE, FAIL, "can't encode link")
 388 
 389     /* Open the fractal heap */
 390     if (NULL == (fheap = H5HF_open(f, linfo->fheap_addr)))
 391         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTOPENOBJ, FAIL, "unable to open fractal heap")
 392 
 393     /* Insert the serialized link into the fractal heap */
 394     if (H5HF_insert(fheap, link_size, link_ptr, udata.id) < 0)
 395         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTINSERT, FAIL, "unable to insert link into fractal heap")
 396 
 397     /* Open the name index v2 B-tree */
 398     if (NULL == (bt2_name = H5B2_open(f, linfo->name_bt2_addr, NULL)))
 399         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTOPENOBJ, FAIL, "unable to open v2 B-tree for name index")
 400 
 401     /* Create the callback information for v2 B-tree record insertion */
 402     udata.common.f             = f;
 403     udata.common.fheap         = fheap;
 404     udata.common.name          = lnk->name;
 405     udata.common.name_hash     = H5_checksum_lookup3(lnk->name, HDstrlen(lnk->name), 0);
 406     udata.common.corder        = lnk->corder;
 407     udata.common.found_op      = NULL;
 408     udata.common.found_op_data = NULL;
 409     /* udata.id already set in H5HF_insert() call */
 410 
 411     /* Insert link into 'name' tracking v2 B-tree */
 412     if (H5B2_insert(bt2_name, &udata) < 0)
 413         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTINSERT, FAIL, "unable to insert record into v2 B-tree")
 414 
 415     /* Check if we should create a creation order index v2 B-tree record */
 416     if (linfo->index_corder) {
 417         /* Open the creation order index v2 B-tree */
 418         HDassert(H5F_addr_defined(linfo->corder_bt2_addr));
 419         if (NULL == (bt2_corder = H5B2_open(f, linfo->corder_bt2_addr, NULL)))
 420             HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTOPENOBJ, FAIL, "unable to open v2 B-tree for creation order index")
